basis: Fixed target and raw source independently inspected before editor proposals. Concrete visible outcomes; implementation, topology and part counts are editor choices.
priorityOrder: Compact useful native shape and construction
Warm coherent palette/volume at logical size
Complete artifact-free registered motion and attachments

hardConstraints.requirement: One fixed 35 degree character orthographic camera; logical 192x320,root 96,248; native 384x640 at scale 2; source atlas rects/layout remain6x2 in 2304x1280. Preserve source orientation convention S 0, E +90, N 180, W -90 including retained child orientation; no per-view/pose fitting or raster correction.
hardConstraints.evidence: Actual native matrices, projected calibration/root and measured rotation per render; exact frame/atlas manifest.

hardConstraints.requirement: Dalia remains dark brown skinned with chocolate curly fringe, short ivory chef hat and ivory coat, teal apron, red necktie and dark shoes; one-cell functional character footprint. Rest/functional height 1.3750000298 with original authored tilt/bob allowance measured per state/frame in source audit; do not enlarge the design to target framing. Useful silhouette/proportion/structure/detail redesigns are permitted within this contract.
hardConstraints.evidence: Evaluated native rest and all 192 frame bounds against source allowance; direct front/side/back visual identity and size comparison.

hardConstraints.requirement: Exactly idle/work/hold/load, each 12 unique runtime frames at 12 fps in all 4 actual facings,192 frames total / 16 clips. Idle/work/hold loop with closing key excluded from atlas; load remains nonloop. Keep planted feet, actual evaluated hand/knife/dish attachments, timing and intended action behavior; no invented walk/station or belt-load flight/release choreography.
hardConstraints.evidence: Complete native raw frame entries, original-layout atlases, per-state/facing12 fps playback and all-frame sheets, source-relative evaluated contacts and loop audit.

hardConstraints.requirement: Editable native 3D character and knife, stable deformation/topology behavior through all frames, complete packed/dependency-closed source. The original held salmon is an explicit 2D attachment exception, retained and identified honestly; no target card, paintover or postprocess recoloring.
hardConstraints.evidence: Reopened native project; material/resource audit; all-mesh evaluated frame counts/structure; frame packet hashes and actual inspected output.

hardConstraints.requirement: One common native material/light configuration for all rotations; horizontal light symmetry and no directional ground cast shadows. Clean actual transparency, no background card, target halo or clipped frame.
hardConstraints.evidence: Numeric settings and actual images on light/gray/dark backgrounds in all required facings.

visibleCriteria.passOutcome: The short hat has a clear compact crown/band with soft volume instead of a blank slab. Face/head, chocolate curls, sleeves/cuffs, hands, apron body and shoes have intentional rounded transitions and a coherent toy-like silhouette in S/E/N/W. The source tiny torso or repeated curl count need not be copied; useful redesign is rewarded.
lookFor: Warm readable head and friendly expression in S and profiles.
A clean hat/hair/ear boundary, no abrupt exposed ends or implausible gaps.
Coherent side/back crown and clothing volumes without flattening unseen views.
A recognizably short cap inside the rest height rather than the target tall toque.
failureExamples: Large flat white dead patch remains on cap.
Hat/head size increase breaks source scale or clearance.
Smoothed blobs merge hair, face or garment layers.
Unchanged awkward geometry defended only by source fidelity.

visibleCriteria.passOutcome: Warm dark brown skin remains distinct from chocolate hair; ivory hat/coat, teal apron, red tie and dark shoes read at logical 192x320. Broad warm highlights and shadows preserve these families without orange/light skin drift, blue apron drift, white blowout or black crushed forms.
lookFor: Face remains legible against fringe and ears.
Red tie remains its own clear accent against ivory and teal.
Ivory retains warm midtone/shape information; teal is rich but not neon.
Same color identity through rotations and poses.
failureExamples: Target orange face copied as identity.
Hat or coat clips to a featureless white patch.
Back hair is a black unstructured mass.
Per-facing recoloring masks light imbalance.

visibleCriteria.passOutcome: Broad soft lighting and restrained highlights show the rounded volumes, with gentle native contact separation at fringe/hat, neck/collar, cuffs/hands, apron layers and feet. The four directions feel like the same object under symmetric warm light; no fixed side-lit hero treatment, pasted rim halo, shiny plastic glare or directional ground shadow.
lookFor: Soft form rolloff over hat and cheeks.
Curves and garment layers remain readable without harsh dark creases.
Back and side volumes receive comparable readable treatment.
Highlights travel coherently with native shape during motion.
failureExamples: Large chalk-white patch or sharp black overlap patch.
One facing becomes materially darker or flatter.
Sparkling highlights, texture swimming or camera-facing shading trick on character.

visibleCriteria.passOutcome: Garments read as constructed layers with a clear collar/cuff treatment, apron bib/waist/pocket hierarchy and shaped red knot/tails. Purposeful details inspired by the target enrich Dalia without crowding her tiny torso; visible material contrast differentiates fabric, curls/skin, shoes and knife.
lookFor: Pocket and waist have visible depth or edge separation at logical size.
Collar and apron straps/bib explain how clothing fits.
Compact purposeful decoration or crafted cues help the silhouette or role.
Knife stays a separate readable working utensil in required work profiles.
failureExamples: Random microdetail becomes noisy pixels.
Pocket/seams disappear entirely at use size while enlarged-only details dominate effort.
New decoration interferes with hands, dish, knife or source clearances.
Adding the exact target button/seam count is treated as mandatory.

visibleCriteria.passOutcome: Dalia reads as one clean friendly chef at logical use size on light/gray/dark, in all 192 native frames. No clipping, halo, holes, coplanar stripes, exposed mesh ends, black seams, abrupt normal changes or flicker. Planted shoes and clothing remain stable; knife follows the working hand; the declared 2D dish remains coherent with the actual source attachment and source-facing visibility caveats.
lookFor: Full 16 per-state/facing playbacks at 12 fps plus all-frame sheets.
Idle/work/hold loop cleanly, load follows original reach-and-return timing with no forced looping policy.
No shoulder/elbow/wrist/neck tears at motion extremes.
Dish and utensil visibility/pivots follow source behavior without new topology popping.
Source comparison acknowledges source N dish occlusion, high visual hold and non-release load.
failureExamples: Missing or mislabeled direction/clip/frame.
Foot sliding/lift or floating attachment caused by excluded-collection evaluation.
Held plane asserted native 3D or its biased world bound used to reject valid body footprint.
New target halo, background pixels or frame fitting.
A claimed belt-load release absent from original source presented as required compliance.

requiredReviewEvidence.pixels: All 192 exact native raw frames, 16 original-layout atlases,verified all-frame sheets at intended size and enlarged,light/gray/dark representatives in every facing,16 actual12 fps motion previews; no single hero render can approve.
requiredReviewEvidence.technical: Hash-bound editable source and dependencies; actual camera/root/scale/rotations; all-frame rest/body/attachment bounds,foot/hand/knife/dish source-relative comparisons,stable evaluated topology and loop policy. Static socket JSON alone does not certify contacts.
requiredReviewEvidence.sourceCaveats: reviews/initial.json actualSourceCaveats and reviews/source-audit-summary.json are binding interpretation context, not permission to worsen source behavior.
requiredReviewEvidence.verdictRule: Approval only after fixed frozen outcomes visibly improve and technical evidence passes. Missing evidence -> needs_evidence. Scores are comparative; no numeric universal pass threshold.

acceptedReferenceDepartures: Keep short compact cap and original functional height while adopting softer construction.
Retain dark brown skin and teal apron despite target/family color drift.
Do not copy target scale/root framing, halo, alpha defects or every tiny seam/button.
Side/back design may be developed coherently because target only shows front.
Keep honest original 2D salmon exception and actual action behavior rather than inventing a native dish/belt trajectory.
